introHtml: Carhartt beanies combine rugged durability with classic style, making them a top choice for outdoor crews, construction teams, and brand giveaways. The Carhartt Watch Cap 2.0 features a stretch-fit design and acrylic construction that holds up to heavy use, while the Acrylic Knit Hat offers a traditional cuff beanie silhouette. Both styles accept screen printing or embroidery, letting you add your logo without sacrificing comfort or warmth. For safety managers and small business owners, these beanies deliver reliable cold-weather performance and long-lasting brand visibility.
